name: poopdeck-pirates
description: A multiplayer pirate game with server-side physics

scripts.build:shared: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.browser.json && shx cp shared/*.json shared/built/ && shx cp shared/*.json shared/browser/
scripts.build:server: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && shx cp shared/*.json server/built/
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && npm run build:shared && npm run build:server
scripts.start: npm run build:all && node -r tsconfig-paths/register server/built/server.js
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && concurrently "tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --watch" "tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --watch" "nodemon --watch server/src server/built/server.js"
